# mistershell_sensor_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell sensor alert rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_sensor_alert_rule" "example" {
  name          = "suppress-selected-alerts"
  enabled       = false
  suppress      = true
  signature_ids = [9900001]
}
```
